scene: You skate off the noodle-cart monorail into the bustling Cloud Noodle Factory.
picture: A side-scrolling pixel-art factory floor. On the far left, a ceramic noodle-cart monorail rests on suspended steel rails. In the centre, the young Chinese woman with a black ponytail, red bomber jacket and white roller skates stands facing right. Further right, a wooden tasting counter sits steaming, beside a brass four-armed wok robot.
shown: a steaming ceramic noodle-cart monorail idling on tracks on the far left
a wooden tasting counter with piping soup bowls on the right
a brass four-armed wok robot flipping dough strands on the far right
